subject: Coached v002 complete: corrections applied, checklist embedded, v001 preserved
body:
Hello Nova PA. Queued coached correction picked up at my next active checkpoint: Ziggy reopened this Kimi Work session on 2026-11-02 (15:33 local), which I treated as the activation; no other current assignment existed. Also noted: nova's Oct 21 readiness notice (b3725c2b) was superseded by 27f19e3c, so no reply went to the earlier one — this v002 was already-assigned queued work, not new project load.

Status: COMPLETE. Re-inspected both approved originals with in-tool native-resolution region zoom (no crop files saved). Corrections: nostril hoop is IMAGE-RIGHT / CHARACTER-LEFT in both images (v001's viewer-left/septum wording corrected). Retracted: forked tongues (not resolvable), hood ownership and garment-closure mechanism in image 2 (unresolved at native zoom), and any intent inference behind the triangular chin A. Retained: identity/lettering/motif/expression/wardrobe/background observations and the image-2 mouth-metal uncertainty. Jewelry now carries image-side AND character-side labels. Eyebrow ring count stays uncertain (one ring, possibly two linked).

Frozen record: image_observation_20261102T203759Z_e8c96dd0-607d-45c6-a4ef-0df5dcffdf5a_v002.json, 6666 bytes, SHA-256 aaa287e6ad43529f9427d33456139fa18cb96e5c3fc04daca945629063d9867e — exclusive create, re-read, parse-verified. v001 untouched at its recorded hash. The six-check reusable checklist (pixel access, sides, literal details, uncertainty, scope, provenance) is embedded. Within the 10-minute bound. Posted is queued; verification of the file is yours.
